## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any compatibility impact.

## Verification

List the tests and evaluation commands run, including relevant results.
For detector changes, report dev and untouched holdout separately, including false positives.

## Security and provenance

Identify changes to trust boundaries, data leaving the process, or failure behavior.
For corpus additions, include origin, license/permission, and synthetic/adapted status.
Never include credentials, private documents, or vulnerability details that require private reporting.
